question: Which deposited Wang count libraries and control alleles support day-4 Treg RNA description?
decision: Qualify library-level descriptions or hold depending on exact source identity and count semantics.
strongest_rival: An incorrect accession/column crosswalk or pooling hidden behind unique run accessions would misstate the comparison.
discriminator: Require GEO count column, GSM, SRX, BioSample genotype and ENA SRR identity. Check integer count semantics and preserve unknown mouse allocation.
exposure_record: Published S3B–C outcomes and Dp1 directions are known. GEO/ENA/BioSample identities, source methods and the count header have been inspected. Subsequent stages explicitly record additional exposure.
biological_unit: Deposited day-4 bulk RNA library; source mouse or pool unit is unknown.
nesting_and_overlap: Nine unique BioSample and library/run accessions. Mouse/pool reuse and processing blocks are unresolved. Wang article and GEO reanalysis are shared-source evidence.
population_and_selection: C57BL/6 initially CD62L-high Tregs cultured for 96 hours with CD3/CD28 stimulation and IL-2. Viable recovered cell composition after culture is unresolved.
contrast: No biological contrast in S1; compare metadata identities across the nine count columns.
endpoint: Library crosswalk, per-library count and detection totals, and matrix qualification.
methods: Exact one-to-one joins across count header, GEO SOFT, ENA and BioSample; require unique stable Ensembl identifiers and nonnegative integer rows; summarize without inspecting genotype effects.
missingness_and_exclusions: Retain all nine libraries and all genes, including zeros. No mouse or batch imputation.
multiplicity: Descriptive outputs only; no gene-level or set-level tests.
precision_basis: No sampling uncertainty is estimated for the finite deposited libraries.
interpretation_limit: No animal-population inference, cell-state or functional effect, tumor specificity or independent replication.
stop_rule: Stop on malformed count data, duplicate identifiers or a failed source join; unresolved biological independence holds statistical inference.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective metadata execution after retrieval and identity-only source review.
